title: Senior Backend Engineer, Growth Platform
description:
Lemonade transformed insurance by replacing legacy processes with automation and machine learning. On the Growth Platform team, you will architect and build a brand-new growth engine: an event-driven platform that ingests customer signals from across our ecosystem to power intelligent decision-making across all customer touchpoints. 

You'll have full architectural ownership of the services and data pipelines that evaluate user context, trigger outreach, and directly influence company growth.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.


IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL

 - Architect, build, and scale backend services that ingest and unify customer data from multiple sources into actionable signals for personalization, recommendations, and lifecycle journeys.

 - Design the decision engines and business logic that orchestrate outreach across communication channels, integrating experimentation frameworks and machine learning models.

 - Partner with product, data, and machine learning colleagues to turn customer insight into features people actually use.

 - Own your services end to end, from code quality and performance to reliability after launch.

 - Spot gaps in how we serve customers and drive the fix yourself.

 - Drive engineering excellence - Mentor engineers and help shape the engineering roadmap of the team as the team grows.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 7+ years building production backend systems that run at scale.

 - A track record of taking a problem from definition to a shipped, running solution with little day-to-day direction.

 - Hands-on experience with at least one modern backend language, plus proof you pick up new stacks and tools quickly.

 - A product mindset: you can explain why your work matters to customers and to the business.

 - A BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent experience.

 - Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

 - Bonus points for
   
   - TypeScript and NestJS, customer lifecycle or CRM data, recommendation systems or experimentation platforms, or open-source contributions.
   
   - Experience with customer lifecycle systems, customer data platforms (CDP), or dynamic experimentation frameworks.
   
   - Experience integrating machine learning model outputs or predictive scores into backend workflows.
   
   -  Active contributions to open-source software.

title: Technical Program Manager, Revenue Operations
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager, Revenue Operations to join our Revenue Operations at Pleo. In this role, you'll help build the technical and operational infrastructure that enables Pleo’s revenue organisation to scale and be part of cross-functional programs as we scale Pleo's customer and revenue lifecycle. If you're excited about solving complex architectural challenges at the intersection of business systems and data and are passionate about SaaS, fintech, and modern Revenue Operations, then this is the opportunity for you!




WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 

You’ll report to our Director of Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Sales, Customer Success, Customer Experience, Marketing, and Customer Onboarding. Our team of Revenue Operations professionals is highly collaborative and dedicated to building a scalable, reliable, and connected revenue operating system. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Product, Engineering, Data and Analytics, Business Systems, and Finance to ensure success.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Technical Program Manager, Revenue Operations, you will:

 - Lead complex technical programs across the revenue technology ecosystem – from discovery and requirements definition through architecture design, implementation, UAT, launch, and post-launch adoption.

 - Translate requirements bidirectionally – turn complex commercial challenges into precise technical specs for Engineering and Data teams, while breaking down technical trade-offs, system dependencies, and risks for business stakeholders.

 - Drive revenue systems and CRM initiatives – optimize architecture and end-to-end data flows across lead-to-opportunity, sales-to-onboarding handoffs, renewal, churn risk, and billing operations.

 - Identify and eliminate technical and operational debt – architect future-state solutions rather than quick fixes, automating manual workflows and improving data integrity across critical revenue systems.

 - Champion modern automation and AI-enabled RevOps capabilities – integrate intelligent workflows, predictive customer health signals, and agent-based workflows to accelerate commercial productivity.

 


WHAT YOU BRING 


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

 - 5+ years of Technical Program Management experience – a proven track record of managing complex technical programs involving multi-system integrations, data models, APIs, and technical dependencies.

 - A strong understanding of the SDLC and revenue mechanics – deep comfort with software development workflows (Agile/hybrid) paired with a solid grasp of the B2B revenue lifecycle (lead routing, pipeline, onboarding, retention, expansion).

 - System architecture fluency – the ability to challenge technical designs, evaluate failure scenarios, define sources of truth, and ensure long-term scalability.

 - Exceptional stakeholder management and influence – strong executive communication skills, high cross-functional influence without direct authority, and the ability to lead governance, risk tracking, and UAT.

 - Experience with HubSpot or another enterprise CRM, modern data warehouses (SQL querying), CPQ/billing tools, or integration middleware.

 - A background in SaaS, fintech, payments, spend management, or a high-growth digital environment.

 


WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You love being the technical bridge between revenue leaders and software/data engineers, translating strategy into scalable technical execution.

 - You think in systems, data flows, and dependencies, and prefer fixing root causes rather than patching symptoms.

 - You want true ownership of strategic programs and enjoy driving them through technical delivery to measurable business adoption.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - Your TPM experience is primarily administrative (focused only on timelines, meeting notes, and status reports without understanding the underlying technical architecture).

 - You are uncomfortable discussing APIs, data schemas, integrations, and failure modes directly with engineers.

 - You need fully defined requirements handed to you rather than proactively untangling ambiguity and challenging assumptions.
   
   


HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE 

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

 - Map Pleo's revenue systems landscape, data flows, and sources of truth, taking ownership of active high-priority technical initiatives.

 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, and commercial leaders to streamline requirements gathering, UAT, and release governance.

 - Grow your skills in scaling cutting-edge RevOps infrastructure, introducing automation and AI-enabled workflows as Pleo expands across markets.

title: Senior Product Engineer - PHP
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Engineer, you'll be a key player in our engineering organisation, a vibrant community of talented engineers spanning backend, frontend, mobile, and platform disciplines. This isn't just about maintaining; it's about innovating. You'll dive into a wide range of exciting projects, from building and integrating new APIs that elevate the customer journey to optimising our cutting-edge lending platforms. You'll also engage in deep architectural discussions, shaping the future of our products. There's ample opportunity to grow, contribute, and truly make your mark.

 


OUR MODERN TECH STACK

We believe in using the right tools for the job, and our stack reflects our commitment to modern, efficient development:

 - Backend: PHP 8, Symfony, AWS, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes

 - CI/CD: GitHub Actions and ArgoCD (we deploy to production as soon as a feature is complete!)

 - Testing: Behat, PHPUnit for robust automated testing




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're seeking passionate engineers who are excited to contribute and grow with us:

 - Strong, business oriented, engineer with modern PHP development experience (PHP 8.0+ is a must). You're fluent in the latest PHP features and best practices.

 - A solid grasp of Symfony or Laravel.

 - Experience with  Domain Driven Design, CQRS, Message-Driven Systems, and Event Sourcing

 - Familiarity with microservices architecture and working on financial systems is a bonus.

 - Excellent automated testing skills (unit, integration, functional) - you believe in quality code.

 - A genuine desire to learn, collaborate, and contribute your ideas within a highly collaborative team.

 - High degree of ownership and autonomy

 - Experience in a cross-functional environment is a plus, but not essential.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

We value your time and have designed an efficient process to get to know you:

 1. 15 minute cognitive assessment 

 2. A quick chat with one of our team to see if the role is a good match.

 3. 90 minute technical live coding exercise

 4. 60 minute culture interview




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog https://blog.lendable.co.uk/!

title: Senior Consulting Engineer - EMEA
description:
ClickHouse is the open-source, real-time analytical database behind a lot of today's AI. More than 4,000 companies build on ClickHouse, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Tesla and Meta.

As a Consulting Engineer, you're the hands-on engineer on our customers' most important projects. When a customer needs to migrate, integrate, or prove ClickHouse on a real workload, you work in the build alongside their engineers: you design it, build it, test it and hand it over.

You'll work on a broad mix of projects for customers across EMEA, from moving large workloads off other databases to building new real-time analytics on ClickHouse. Each one is scoped with clear goals from the start, so you know what success looks like and can get stuck in. It's a fast way to build deep experience across lots of different data problems.

The consulting function at ClickHouse is less than a year old, so you'll help shape how ClickHouse delivers this work as the team grows. Between projects you take cases alongside support engineers, which keeps you close to day-to-day support.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Turn customer goals into a scoped project with measurable success criteria, sizing and a timeline

 - Design a target architecture and prove it against the customer's own data: schema and engine design, capacity and sizing, proofs of concept

 - Do the build: implementation, pipelines and integrations, migration execution, tooling and automation

 - Measure it before it matters, with benchmarking, load and functional testing, then support the cutover

 - Tune what production reveals, then hand over with an engagement report and knowledge transfer, so the customer's team can run it without you

 - Take L1 to L3 cases alongside support engineers when you're between projects

 - Feed what you see in the field back to Product and Engineering, and turn your work into reference architectures, knowledge base articles and blog posts

 - Work in a constant feedback loop with the Pre-sales team to ensure that the demos and POCs they present are credible when you put them into production

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years delivering hands-on technical work for customers, whether your title was consultant, professional services, solutions architect, senior support, SRE or something else

 - Real depth in databases, whether analytical, transactional or relational

 - Hands-on SQL. You regularly write complex queries from scratch, and tune and debug them yourself

 - You've owned implementations, migrations or POCs for external customers from start to finish

 - Hands-on cloud experience (AWS, GCP and/or Azure)

 - You've deployed and run workloads on Kubernetes yourself

 - You give precise technical answers and explain them clearly

 - Fluent English

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with ClickHouse

 - Hands-on Splunk experience

 - Migrating analytical workloads from systems such as PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery or Elastic

 - Terraform

 - Data pipelines and streaming, such as Kafka, Kinesis, Spark or Debezium

 - Python, Bash or Go

 - Involvement in open source, as a user, contributor or community member

GOOD TO KNOW

 - This role is remote within EMEA, in a country where ClickHouse already hires

 - Travel to customer sites is part of the job, up to 35% of your time, depending on the project: some need none, others weekly visits

 - You'll join our EMEA Support Services team, where Support Engineers, Consulting Engineers and TAM Architects work as one team

 - You'll be part of the on-call rotation, about one week a quarter, with time off in lieu if you're paged at a weekend

HOW WE HIRE

 - A 30-minute call with our recruiter

 - A conversation with the hiring manager

 - A take-home exercise, designed to take three to four hours, with three working days to complete it

 - A 90-minute technical interview with the team: you'll walk us through your take-home, then join a working session where you write and tune SQL live

 - A final conversation with our VP of Support Services

 - References, then an offer

The working session is without AI tools, so make sure you're comfortable writing queries from scratch. Download open-source ClickHouse and practise: it's free, easy to install, and great preparation.


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & PRIVACY

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here https://clickhouse.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice for our Privacy Statement.

The cloud was built to run software, not to support AI-native development workflows. As the world's leading local cloud development platform, LocalStack provides secure local sandboxes that simulate cloud environments, enabling AI agents and software developers to find and fix risks faster and more effectively than they can in the cloud.

Our customer base ranges from SMBs to Global Fortune 500 companies. Our clients include companies like NASA, Harness, IBM, Workday, Comcast, Apple, 3M, Block and many more.

 - Directly manage and develop the Data team through regular one-to-ones, feedback, performance management, and hiring.

 - Experience building reusable datasets, documentation, or a metrics / BI layer that non-data teams adopted and used without help

We chase excellence by pushing boundaries and delivering results that go beyond the ordinary, constantly raising the bar and striving for greatness in everything we do. Excellence is not just the outcome, itʼs how we approach every task with purpose, passion, and a commitment to delivering exceptional value.

🎁 Benefits

SOUNDS LIKE A GOOD MATCH?

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Our Team Members:
We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

Your Role:
Your Role:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the developer platform that agents and partners use to integrate and build on. You evolve Alpaca’s MCP servers, tools, and skills, and you build the APIs behind them.
You play a central role to define the architecture that provides the fastest time to market for integrators. Builders who embed Alpaca for their end users all use this surface.

• Proficiency in Python or TypeScript, and a willingness to work primarily in Go.
• Strong architectural judgment, with a record of shipping while requirements are still being defined.
• Clear communication with engineers, product, compliance, and risk partners.

• Experience or understanding of financial markets

• Experience working at a startup.
• Experience working remotely.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design and ship autonomous execution for agents acting on Alpaca accounts. The same platform has to serve external algorithmic traders, partners building products on Alpaca, operators, and partners who embed Alpaca so their end users’ agents can act.
You will design and ship account-level policy and the checks on the path in front of our trading and risk systems. You will work with the engineers who own our MCP servers, tools, and skills, and with the team that owns authentication and authorization. You will help Product, Compliance, and Risk shape the control model, and you will ship the implementation.

Things You Get To Do:
• Lead the application architecture for safe agent execution, from the tool call through to our trading systems.
• Design and build the account-level policy and guardrails for external agent actions.
• Own the services that evaluate those rules on the path into our trading systems.
• Define how agent-initiated trading actions behave, with the engineers who own our tools and skills.
• Keep Alpaca’s execution model current with the MCP protocol and with connector, plugin, and skill standards, and translate what changes into account policy, guardrails, and trading actions.
• Partner with Product, Compliance, Risk, and the identity platform to define the control model and ship it.
• Own production reliability for the policy and guardrail services.
• Review designs across teams and guide the technical decisions where agent actions meet brokerage systems.
• Mentor engineers and raise the quality of design and implementation in this area.
Who You Are (Must-Haves):
• 5+ years of software engineering experience, building and operating production backend systems. Evidence of scope and ownership matters more than a strict year count.
• Shipped autonomous execution: software that took actions under an explicit policy without a person approving each action, and that rejected or stopped actions outside that policy.
• Designed and implemented account-level policy in an application: durable rules for what a caller may do, enforced on the action path, with an audit of the decision.
• Enough MCP architecture to work with stateless and stateful behavior, and experience building to MCP, or to connector, plugin, or skill standards, as they have changed in production.
• Able to define, with Product, Compliance, and Risk, which account rules allow an unattended action.
• Proficiency in Python or TypeScript, and a willingness to work primarily in Go.
• Strong architectural judgment, with a record of shipping while requirements are still being defined.
• Clear communication with engineers, product, compliance, and risk partners.
Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):
• Experience with agent identity and authorization, such as OAuth, tokens, scopes, and delegated access, and comfort partnering with the team that owns that platform.
• Experience shipping developer-facing tools, SDKs, or MCP servers.
• Experience building agents with a framework such as LangChain.
• Experience or understanding of financial markets.
• Experience working at a startup.
• Experience working remotely.
How We Take Care of You:
• Competitive Salary & Stock Options
• Health Benefits
• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card
Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
ABOUT HELIUS

Helius is building the core infrastructure for Solana - empowering developers to create the next generation of crypto-powered applications. Our mission is to accelerate the development of internet capital markets by making it easier, faster, and more intuitive to build on-chain.



Thousands of teams - from early-stage startups to industry leaders like Coinbase, Phantom, and Jupiter - rely on Helius APIs, webhooks, and indexing tools to power their products. Backed by Haun Ventures, Founders Fund, and Foundation Capital, we’re a small, senior team obsessed with performance, simplicity, and scalability in decentralized systems.



Read our Helius Manifesto https://www.helius.dev/blog/manifesto to see how we work and what we value.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Solutions Engineer who thrives on being the go-to technical resource for developers building on Solana. You'll own the customer support experience — answering hard questions in real time, unblocking integrations, and turning recurring pain points into better products, docs, and tooling.

This is a hybrid role: part technical support, part solutions engineering, and part internal engineering partner. You'll be embedded in our developer community day-to-day, spotting patterns in what customers need and shipping code, demos, and automation that raise the bar for the entire Helius developer experience.

We move quickly and bias toward ownership. If you're energized by helping developers succeed — and by the distributed systems and crypto infrastructure powering that work — you'll thrive here.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Serve as the technical front door for developers using Helius APIs and streaming products

 - Troubleshoot issues, reproduce bugs, and work with engineering to get fixes shipped

 - Build code samples, demos, and SDKs that help customers integrate faster

 - Rewrite and expand documentation, tutorials, and guides based on real-world questions

 - Automate support workflows using internal tooling, scripts and AI-assisted systems

 - Collaborate with engineering on feature requests, bug reports, and customer-driven improvements

 - Live in Discord and Telegram to support developers, gather feedback, and spot new patterns

 - Partner with enterprise and ecosystem teams to design integrations and optimize performance

 - Prototype new experimental features alongside engineers and product owners based on customer feedback
   




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 1-2 years of experience in a technical role (support, engineering, solutions or devrel)

 - Excitement for the Solana ecosystem, distributed systems, and internet capital markets

 - Comfort reading and writing code (TypeScript & Rust preferred)

 - Deep curiosity, bias for action, and ownership

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially when breaking down complex technical ideas

 - Passion for helping developers and improving developer experience




NICE TO HAVE 

 - Prior experience in a developer-facing support or solutions role with high volume or real-time community support (Discord, Telegram, forums)

 - Experience with APIs, SDK design, or open-source contributions

 - Prior startup experience or work in a small, fast-moving team



WHY HELIUS?

 - High-impact work: Your code will power applications used by millions across the Solana ecosystem, including Coinbase, Jupiter, and Phantom

 - Ownership & growth: Lead critical initiatives, influence architecture and product direction, and take on more responsibility as the company scales

 - Remote-first flexibility: Work where you’re most effective with a flexible, fully distributed team

 - Competitive comp & perks: Market-leading salary, meaningful equity, generous vacation, wellness budgets, and support for learning and travel

 - Mission-driven team: Join ambitious builders who move fast, take ownership, and are shaping the future of decentralized apps
